verdict.rationale: Angular is a framework, not a data-holding service, so the closest fit is local isolated testing. The CLI runs unit tests (`ng test`) and serves the app for end-to-end tests (`ng e2e`), and the docs offer an in-browser playground and tutorials that need no real project. None of this is described as a sandbox environment isolated from production data. Missing for 10: documented sandbox or test-mode environment, explicit data isolation from production (e.g. HTTP mocking or test backends), agent-oriented sandbox workflows, and independent corroboration.
